title: Elementary scalar tensors and normalized inverse-image comparison
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ be sites small in the coefficient and module universe [def-weil-size-convention], $A,B$ sheaves of commutative rings on $C$, $A',B'$ sheaves of commutative rings on $D$, and $a:A\to B$, $a':A'\to B'$ ring maps. For an $A$-module sheaf $M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], define $\operatorname{scalarPure}_{a,M,U}(b,m)$ to be the image of the balanced tensor $b\otimes m$ under the unit [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-section-calculus] from the sectionwise change-of-rings presheaf to its module sheafification $B\otimes_A M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $F:\operatorname{Sh}(C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(D)$ be a functor and let $I_A,I_B$ be algebraic inverse-image presentations [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image] for $(A,A')$ and $(B,B')$, with ring identifications $e_A,e_B$ and underlying-module identifications $e_M:|I_A M|\cong F|M|$ and $e_N:|I_B N|\cong F|N|$. For a natural isomorphism $\chi:(B\otimes_A-)I_B\cong I_A(B'\otimes_{A'}-)$, define $\operatorname{IsScalarInverseImageComparison}(F,I_A,I_B,a,a',\chi)$ as the following normalization predicate: for every module $M$, test sheaf $T$, and arrows $s:T\to|B|$, $m:T\to|M|$, $z:T\to|B\otimes_A M|$ satisfying $z_U(t)=\operatorname{scalarPure}_{a,M,U}(s_U(t),m_U(t))$ on every section, one has on every section of $FT$ the equation $\chi_M(e_{B\otimes M}^{-1}Fz)=\operatorname{scalarPure}_{a',I_A M}(e_BFs,e_M^{-1}Fm)$. This defines a predicate, without asserting existence of a normalized isomorphism or requiring the ring square to commute.
